vya_text: dI0 - atha madhyamaKaNDaH prAraByate | tatrAdau kaShAyasaMj~jakavRuttamAha - athAta iti | athaSabdo ma~ggalArthaH | ata iti prathamaKaNDAnantaram | ete pa~jcakaShAyA j~jeyAH | te yathottaraM laGavaH syuriti | yo yasmAduttaro yathottaram | te ke ? svarasakalkakkAthahimaPANTasaMj~jAH | svarasa iti sadyorasaH, kalko dRuShadi peShitaH, kvAthaH kkathitaH kaShAyaH, hima iti SItakaShAyaH, PANTa iti jalaplAvitaM cUrNam ||1|| atha teShu pUrvaM svarasakalpanAmAha - tallakShaNaM yathA – AhatAditi - IdRuSAddravyAt samudBavo rasaH sa svarasa ityucyate, kIdRuSAt ? tamAha - AhatAt kShatAt SakalIkRutAt tatkShaNAkRuShTAditi sadya utpATitAt | kShuNNAditi ulUKalAdiShu musalAdiBiH kuTTitAt | vastraniShpIDita iti paTena parisruto rasa iti SeShaH | dravyAditi sAmAnyagrahaNenAtra tva~gmUlaPalAdInAM grahaNam || lakShaNAntaramAha - kuDavamityAdi | ceti pakShAntareNApi svarasaH kathitaH, sa yathA - kuDavapramANaM cUrNIBUtadravyaM dviguNajale kShipta- mahorAtraM sthitaM Bavati tasmAd yo raso jAta utpannaH so~api svarasa uttamo j~jeyaH | kuDavagrahaNamatra sakalamAnadyotanArtham | ahorAtragrahaNenaiva himakaShAyAdBinno j~jAtavyaH | matAntaramapi yathA - AdAyetyAdi | svarasAnAmasaMBave avidyamAne SuShkadravyaM kShuNNaM yathAparimA- NamAdAya gRuhItvA aShTaguNitapAnIye sAdhyaM kathitamityarthaH | tasmAt yat pAdAvaSeShaM Bavati tasyApi svarasasaMj~jA | yathA parimANAdinA kvAthAdBinnametat | idAnImanukteShu pAnArthaM parimANapUrvakaM prakShepamAha - svarasasyeti | svarasasya Adye ardhaM palaM prayojayet | pAnArthamityarthaH | niHSoShitamagnisiddhaM ca svarasaM palamAtraM pibedityarthaH | tayoH kiMcillaGutvAt || 2-5 ||

gU0 - dvitIyaKaNDe Adau svarasAdInAmaBidhAnAtsvarasAdInAha - athAta ityAdi | atheti rogagaNanAnantaraM svarasaH, kalkaH, kvAthaH, himaH, PANTaH, ete pa~jca kaShAyA j~jeyAH – te ca yathottaraM laGavaH syuriti yojanA | yathottaramiti svarasAtkalko laGuH evamuttaraM j~jeyam | nanu svaraso gururBavati tasyApekShayA anye laGavastatkathaM tasyaivAdAvaBidhAnam, svarasasya gurutve prathamatve pramANamAha - `svarasasya gurutvAcca palamardhaM prayojayet' (iti)| ucyate, svarasasya kvathitAdigauravakriyABAvAdAdAvaBidhAnam | yadvA laGvapekShayA guruH pUjyaH ataH svarasasya gurutvAdAdAvaBidhAnaM, tathAcoktaM vAgBaTe BeShajakalpanAsthAne - `rasaH kalkaH SRutaH SItaH PANTaSceti prakalpanA | pa~jcadhaivaM kaShAyANAM pUrvaM pUrvaM balAdhikA' | kaShAyA iti kaShAyadravyasAdhitatvAt, yadvA kaShAyAH kaShAyanAmAnaH | saMj~jAparo~ayaM kaShAyaSabdaH ||1|| teShu svarasakalpanAmAha - evaMBUtAt kShuNNAtkRuTTitAddravyAt yaH vastraniShpIDito raso Bavetsa svarasa ucyate | kiMBUtAddravyAt | AhatAt SastrAdinA CinnAdityarthaH, `AhataH syAtpratIGAte AhataM kShatite~api ce'ti viSvakoShaH | AhatAt na hatam ahataM tasmAt | kRumyagnyAdiBiradUShitAt kRumyAdidUShitasya BeShajakalpe niShedhAt, yadvA tatkShaNAkRuShTAditi vA pAThaH | tatkShaNAkRuShTAt tatkShaNa AnItAt| svarasasya prakArAntaramAha - kuDavamiti | catuHpalaM cUrNitadravyamauShadhaM punardviguNe aShTa- palamite jale kShiptam ahorAtraM sthitaM tasmAt pAtrAdvastrapUtaM gRuhItaM sa vA uttamo rasaH svaraso Bavet| ArdradravyABAve SuShkadravyasyApi svaraso BavedityAha - AdAyeti | sa rasaH svarasAnAM ArdradravyANAM vA asamBave SuShkaM AdAya aShTaguNe jale sAdhyaM pAdaSiShTaSca gRuhyate punargRuhItatvAtsvarasasya gurutvAt palamardhaM prayujyate cet niHSoShitaM rAtristhApitaM agnisiddhaM cet palamAtraM pibediti yojanA | nanu idaM svarasalakShaNaM rAtristhitatvAddhimalakShaNe agnipakvAtkvAthakShaNe ca vyaBicarati | yataH vAgBaTe idaM svarasalakShaNaM liKitaM `sadyaHsamuddhRutakShuNNAt yaH sravetpaTapIDanAt | vastraniShpIDito yaH sa svaraso rasa ucyate' ato lakShaNe vyaBicAraH ? ucyate, idaM tantrAntaramataM, yadvA ShoDaSaguNe nIre siddhaM Bavati, svaraso~aShTaguNe nIre BavatIti BedaH ||2-5||

pada: SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAm - madhyamaKaNDa: atha svarasAdhyAya : | athAtaH svarasaH kalkaH kvAthaSca himaPANTakau | j~jeyAH kaShAyAH pa~jjaite laGavaH syuryathottaram || 1 ||

vya_text: dI0 - tatra prakShepamAha - madhvityAdi | madhvAdikaM kolamAtraM yathA syAttathA kShipet | kolaM palasya cAShTAMSam | madhvitisAmAnyagrahaNena tajjAtayo~aShTau gRuhyante | tadyathA - ``pautikaM BrAmaraM kShaudraM mAkShikaM CAtrameva ca| ArGyamauddAlakaM dAlamityaShTau madhujAtayaH'' iti | evamaviSeShoktau sarvatra | SvetA sitaSarkarA, guDaM prasiddhaM, tadupalakShitatvenAnye ikShuvikArA yathA doShApekShayA gRuhyante | kShArAniti bahuvacanatvena sarve kShArAH, anukte yavakShArameva sarvatra | jIrakaM prasiddhaM sAmAnyagrahaNena pItakRuShNAdikam, aviSeShe SvetajIrakameva | lavaNamiti sAmAnyena pa~jcalavaNAni gRujjate, tadyathA -`sindhusauvarcalopetaM viDaM sAmudrajodBidaM' #foot@1-‘gaNDam’ pA0 | 2-idaM nAsti ‘Ka’ pustake |rasaH# iti | anukte tu saindhavameva grAhyaM sarvatra | GRutatailaM pakvApakvaM nAnAvidham | tatrAnukte tu gavyaM GRutaM tilatailaM ca pradhAnamiti | tathAhi - `GRuteShu goGRutaM SreShThaM taileShu tilajaM tathA' iti | cUrNAdIniti vyoShacUrNAdIn | AdigrahaNena kShAramUtrAriShTaSuktAdayo rogApekShayA gRuhyante | yadvA guTikAvalehAdayo~apyAdiSabdena grAhyAH || 6 ||

gU0 - idAnIM svarase prakShepapramANamAha - rase svarase prakShepaNArthamuktAn madhvAdIn kolamAtrAn kShipet | kolaSabdena Ta~gkadvayamucyate | agnyapekShayA vA deyaM, yataH `mAtrAyA na vyavasthAsti vyAdhiM koShThaM balaM vayaH | Alocya deSakAlau ca yojyA tadvacca kalpanA ||' iti pariBAShAyAmuktam|| 6 ||

pada: prakShepapramANam| madhu SvetA guDaM kShArAn jIrakaM lavaNaM tathA | GRutaM tailaM cUrNAdInkolamAtrAnrase kShipet || 6 ||

vya_text: dI0 – svarasAnAha - sa yatheti | amRutA #foot@2-idaM nAsti ‘Ka’ pustake |# guDUcI tasyA rasaH sadyorasaH kShaudrayukta iti madhuprakShiptaH | sarvagrahaNeneti viMSatirmehAH | prayogAntaramAha - dhAtryA iti | dhAtryA rasaH sadyaskaH kvathito vA haridrAcUrNayukto madhuyukto vA | sarvagrahaNenAyamapi sarvapramehajidBavatIti tAtparyArthaH | vAgrahaNena haridrAyA: kalkamapi deyam | tathAca tantrAntare - `niSAkalkayuto dhAtrIraso vA mAkShikAnvita:| madhunA triPalAcUrNaM pramehANAM vinASanam' iti ||7||

gU0 - atha vyAdhipratyanIkArthaM bahUn svarasAn darSayannAha - sa yatheti | etasyAyamartha: sa: svarasaH yathA Bavati tathA ucyate, amRutA guDUcI tasyA rasa: svarasa: madhuyukta: sarvapramehajidBavati athavA dhAtryA AmalakyA rasaH haridrAcUrNayuktaH samAkShikaH sarvapramehajidBavatIti pUrveNAnvayaH | kartavyatA tu pUrvoktaiva || 7 ||

pada: amRutAsvarasaH | sa yathA #foot@sa yatheti | sa yathA ityAdivAkyena prayogAn prakaTayati granthakAraH, athavA guNayuktij~jApanArthaM SiShyavacanamidaM evaM sarvatra ‘sa yathe’ti j~jAtavyam |# - amRutAyA rasaH kShaudrayuktaH sarvapramehajit | haridrAcUrNayukto vA raso dhAtryAH samAkShikaH ||7||

vya_text: dI0 - vAsaka ityAdi | vAsakaH ATarUShakaH, tasya patrANi iti vyavahArAt | madhuneti prakShepaH ayaM cordhvage raktapitte viSeSheNa yojyaH | SeShaM sugamam || triPalAyA iti | triPalAdInAM caturNAM svarasAH kAmalAM GnantIti | tatra triPalAdArvyo: kvathitarasaH, nimbaguDUcyostu sadyorasa eva | madhuprakShepa eShu caturShu yogeShu j~jeyaH | triPalA viKyAtA sAtra harItakyAdikA | yadyapi triPalASabdena drAkShAkASmaryaparUShakANyucyante | taduktaM - `pathyAviBItadhAtrIBistriPalA mahatI smRutA | hrasvA kASmaryamRudvIkAparUShakaPalairBavet' iti | tathApi sarvatra guNaprAdhAnyAdaviSeShoktau harItakyAdInyena triPalASabdena gRuhyante | dArvI dAruharidrA tasyAstvak grAhyA, tvagaBAve kAShThameveti sarvatra || 8 || 9 ||

gU0 - atha vAsakAdisvaraso raktapittAdau | dArvI dAruharidrA spaShTamanyat | vAsakasvarasaH madhunA peyaH raktapittajidBavati vAsakasvarasaH ardhapalaM madhu TaMkadvayaMmuKAtplutaM raktaM tathA jvarAdiharaH triPalAsvarasaH madhuyuta: tathA dArvI dAruharidrAsvarasaH madhuyuta: kAmalAdinASako Bavati || 8 || 9 ||

pada: raktapittAdiShu vAsakAdisvarasaH | vAsakaH svarasaH peyo madhunA raktapittajit | jvarakAsakShayaharaH kAmalASleShmapittahA || 8 || triPalAyA rasaH kShaudrayukto dArvIraso~atha vA | nimbasya vA guDUcyA vA pIto jayati kAmalAm|| 9 ||

vya_text: dI0 - pIta iti - droNapuShpI `gumA' iti loke | maricacUrNamapyatra prakShiptaM, tacca tIkShNatvAnmAShakadvayamiti vyavahAraH | viShamajvarAnityaikAhikAdIn ||10||

gU0 - atha viShamajvare tulasIsvarasamAha - maricacUrNena pItaH tulasIpatrajaH rasaH svarasaH droNapuShpIsvaraso vA pItaH viShamajvarAnsantatAdIn nihanti | droNapuShpI gUmASAkaH kaTUShNatvAtkarSha: rasaH maricaM mAShakamAtraM mAtrAyA: sthitirnAstItyuktatvAt || 10 ||

pada: viShamajvare tulasIdroNapuShpIsvarasau | pIto maricacUrNena tulasIpatrajo rasaH | droNapuShShIraso vApi nihanti viShamajvarAn ||10||

vya_text: dI0 - jambvAmreti | jambvAdInAM pallavodBavo raso madhvAdiyukto~atIsAraM jayet | pallavagrahaNena komalapatrANItyuktam | AjyaM GRutaM, kShIraM dugdham | eke `madhvAjakShIrasaMyukta'miti paThanti vyAdhyukta- tvAt | tathAhi - `AjaM SoShajvaraSvAsaraktapittAtisArajit, iti | ulbaNamiti vRuddhaM, cirakAlasthitamityanye || 11 ||

pada: raktAtisAre jambvAdisvarasaH | jambvAsrAmalakInAM ca pallavottho raso jayet | madhvAjyakShIrasaMyukto raktAtIsAramulbaNam ||11||

pada: babbUla – syonAka - kuTajasvarasAH | sthUlababbUlikApatrarasa: pAnAdvyapohati | sarvAtisArAnsyonAkakuTajatvagraso~athavA || 12 ||

pada: pArSvAdiSUleShu - bIjapUrasvarasaH | bIjapUrarasaH pAnAnmadhukShArayuto jayet | pArSvahRuddhastiSUlAni koShThavAyuM ca dAruNam || 14 ||

gU0 - alambuShA muNDI tasyAH svarasaH dvipalamAtrayA pIta: apacI gaNDamAlA tasyAH kAmalAyASca nASako Bavati pUrvAnukramamapi dvipalaM svarasapAnaM yaduktaM tasyAyamaBiprAyaH | ardhapalaM paScAt dvipalaM saptakadvayAnantaram || 16 ||
